Strategy: Keep the sweet band between thirty and forty-five but widen the penalty to residuals between five and twenty-five, pushing harder away from a broader awkward range. This may clear more unusable leftovers, but the wider penalty may also punish residuals that later items could use.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 5 and r - item <= 25 else 0) for r in bins]
```
